description.value: Night Hotel Broadway is a hotel on the Upper West Side, New York City. It sits on Broadway with easy subway access to Midtown and downtown. The area offers Central Park, Riverside Park and many neighborhood restaurants within a few blocks. Trip.com shows 6.7 / 10 64 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The location is outstanding, just 2-3 minutes from 96th Street”; “the staff cleans and makes the beds every day”. Representative watch-outs: “hotel is somewhat out dated”.
